`editor-map.msav` is the unmodified `maps/default/debrisField.msav` bundled with the pinned official Mindustry v160.5 runtime. Mindustry is GPL-3.0 licensed (https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry).

The 400 × 400 map exercises partition loading and preservation of real terrain, buildings, rules and waves. Editor E2E tests export it through the official writer and reload it through the official reader. No test implements a custom Mindustry binary reader or writer.
